description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractJob' implementing the 'Job' interface, providing common functionality for job management such as state handling, execution, timing, and transaction cleanup within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: AbstractJob
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic job with state management, execution, timing, and transaction handling capabilities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the job.

methods.name: setCurrentState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the job.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the job (overrides interface method).

methods.name: getJobId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the job.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Transitions the job to the QUEUED state; throws exception if not in CREATED state.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Transitions the job back to the CREATED state; throws exception if not in QUEUED state.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the job logic; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the job, handles transaction cleanup, and measures runtime.

methods.name: getRuntime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time of the job execution.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the job.
